title: Price Layer
description: Single source of truth for every price displayed on the site. Referenced by slug everywhere (city pages, costs page, guides). Year-stamped to prevent price-drift (fixes AJ Long's price-drift bug, teardown §11). Blueprint §2 item 4. File location: data/price_layer.json (one file, all prices). Each entry is a price point for a specific service line item.

slug.description: Unique identifier for this price point (e.g., 'panel-upgrade-200a-standard'). Referenced by service_city_facts and templates.

service_slug.description: Which service this price belongs to.

year.description: Year this price was verified. Stale after 12 months — flag for refresh.

amount_type.description: How this price should be displayed.

amount_low.description: Low end (for 'range') or the single amount (for 'fixed', 'starting_at', 'per_unit', 'hourly').

amount_high.description: High end (for 'range'). Omit for non-range types.

unit.description: Unit description for per_unit/hourly types (e.g., 'per outlet', 'per hour').

includes_note.description: What's included in this price (e.g., 'labor + standard panel + permit filing').

excludes_note.description: What's excluded (e.g., 'does not include meter base replacement if required by utility').

source_note.description: How this price was determined (e.g., 'client-provided 2026-Q2', 'HomeAdvisor + local market').

display_template.description: Optional pre-formatted display string (e.g., '$1,800 – $3,500'). If omitted, renderer formats from amount_low/high + amount_type.

prices.description: Array of all price entries. One number, one place, year-stamped.
